subject.title: fix(plugins): stream hash oversized files in safeHashFile

question: Should installed-plugin index hashing adopt the new 50 MiB streaming threshold and reject non-regular file descriptors, despite current baseline hashing any readable file to EOF?
rationale: The branch's digest loop and proof are sound, but deciding the acceptable input contract and resource policy is maintainer product/runtime ownership rather than a mechanically inferable bug repair.

options.title: Approve bounded streaming contract
options.body: Confirm that installed-plugin records must resolve only to regular files and land the implementation with caller-boundary coverage.

options.title: Retain existing read contract
options.body: Keep the current whole-file behavior and close or narrow this PR because the claimed partial-hash regression is not present in the visible baseline.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded streaming contract
